comparison.objective: Wipe a monitor lead from its plug end to its clip end in one continuous pass.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and tension a flexible lead while maintaining wiping contact along its complete length and around end bodies.
comparison.success_condition: All marked lead regions and both end bodies are wiped, and the entire lead ends on the drape without loss or unsafe handling.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous contact along a deformable cable and coordinated wiping, not rigid impact fracture or small-fragment retrieval.
